prepareBodyScript.label: JavaScript code for computation
prepareBodyScript.placeholder: ex: this.Title += ' (copied)'; this.Alias = null; return JSON.stringify(this);
prepareBodyScript.description:
If provided, the system executes the JavaScript code above to recalculate the BOBY from the webhook in a normal context, or calculate all data for the webhook to be forwarded when this is used as a forwarder.

In a normal context, the this parameter is the object containing the BODY of the outgoing webhook. Two parameters are available: '__request' contains the webhook sending request (__request.Body is the object containing the original BODY), and '__params' contains organization (__params.Organization), business module (__params.Module) and business data type (__params.ContentType) information.

In a forwarding context, the this parameter is a JSON object containing all necessary information for the webhook to be forwarded. Two parameters are available: '__request' contains the webhook sending request (including 3 parameters: __request.Header, __request.Query, __request.Body), and '__params' contains organization (__params.Organization), business module (__params.Module) and business data type (__params.ContentType) information.

This JSON object must contain the following parameters:
  • Verb (string): HTTP Verb to use when forwarding (GET, POST, PUT, PATCH, DELETE)
  • EndpointURL (string): destination address for forwarding
  • EndpointURLs (string array): destination addresses for forwarding
  • Header (json): header parameters for forwarding
  • Query (json): query-string parameters for forwarding
  • Body (json): content of the forwarded webhook
Note: The signature will automatically be added to the forwarded webhook according to the settings above.

SubTitleFormula.label: Subtitle calculation expression
SubTitleFormula.description:
The calculation expression can use one of 2 approaches:
  • Use an expression: start with '@', using @script/@javascript/@js or @[...] for a JavaScript calculation expression with the 'this' object and 2 available parameters, '__request' and '__params', for example: @[return "abc xyz " + this.Title;]
  • Use a {{ }} template with predefined calculation functions such as @current/@object, @request, @params, @toString, ..., for example: This is the subtitle of {{@object(Title)}}
